camel_example: aliyun polardb ResetAccountPassword --region cn-hangzhou --DBClusterId 'pc-000' --AccountName your_account_name --AccountPassword Test1111
description_en: Resets the password for a PolarDB database account
kebab_example: aliyun polardb reset-account-password --db-cluster-id pc-000 --account-name your_account_name --account-password Test1111 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetAccountPassword

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The new password for the database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

Contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

Be 8 to 32 characters in length.

The special characters are `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh:
账号密码，需符合如下要求：
至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意三种。
长度为8~32个字符。
特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: account_password
